description.name: Entry
description.text: Fifteen single attacks (0.60 each), grants [Attach Fire], [Awoken Fire], [Damage Cap +10000], [Stoneskin: 100%] and [Gleed Surge Mode] to the user

description.name: Awoken Fire
description.text: Fire abilities don't consume uses and deal 5/10/15/20/30% more damage at ability rank 1/2/3/4/5, Fire abilities trigger 1 additional time

description.name: Attach Fire
description.text: Replaces Attack command, increases Fire damage dealt by 50/80/120% (abilities) or 80/100/120% (Soul Breaks), Fire resistance +20%

description.name: Stoneskin: 100%
description.text: Reduces damage taken to 0, up to an amount equal to 100% of the character's maximum HP, removed when that amount is reached

description.name: Gleed Surge Mode
description.text: Critical chance =100%, casts Crimson Straight after using 3 Fire abilities, removed if the character doesn't have any Stoneskin

description.name: Crimson Straight
description.text: Eight single attacks (0.66 each), grants [Stoneskin: 100%] to the user
